title: Wire the audit into the CI snippets and document the setting
goal: Core and Angular CI run the audit step and the procedure names how to move from warn to enforce
acceptance: `core/.github/workflows/` and `angular/.github/workflows/` gain an audit step after install; the script `audit:dependencies` is in `package-scripts.json`
The documentation names the setting, the warn-then-enforce path and that a failing audit under `enforce` is a finding to fix or record, never a reason to bypass the check
`check:tooling` accepts a project whose CI has the step and notes one that lacks it (warning, not failure, until a project enforces)
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Fixtures are invented.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Two workflow edits, one script entry and a documentation paragraph. Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the report's effort column. Not a measurement.
